description: This file defines a template-based data structure for handling Type-Length-Value (TLV) encoding, including Request, Response, and Buffer classes, as well as a message exchange class template for communication over a channel, with synchronization and data serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: A template struct implementing TLV encoding with nested Request, Response, and Buffer classes for serialization, copying, and buffer management.

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: A template class managing message exchange over a channel with synchronization, including methods for sending, receiving, and slot management.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TLV data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another Request object if types match.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next buffer block if available.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream buffer into the TLV structure.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the synchronization event with a timeout.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the synchronization event.
